title: Metric, denominator and interpretation contract
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Define the unit, numerator or observation, denominator or comparator, null/zero rule, and clustering/interpretation boundary for the core claim, field, provenance, report, resource, reliability and human-review measures.

fixed_formulas.formula: supported emitted claims / all emitted claims eligible for scoring
correctly emitted gold claims / all gold claims required by scope
2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), only when precision and recall are defined and their sum is positive
emitted claims without gold/evidence support / emitted claims
emitted claims satisfying the frozen support rule / emitted claims
correctly flagged gold conflicts / all gold conflicts
eligible emitted claims with source ID, locator, applicable publisher, retrieval time, checksum and period / eligible emitted claims

held_denominators: Identity, acquisition, temporal and source-quality layer eligibility.
Schema-validity and extraction attempted-versus-eligible and record-versus-field scope.
Normalisation and missing-state labelled field set by task/data type.
Locator-validity eligible locator/claim set and multiple-locator treatment.
Report-section required set and explicit held/empty treatment.
Human-time aggregation and authorised paired comparator.
Machine-stage summary aggregation and failure-inclusive comparator.
Repeat set, outcome-vector scope, denominator and stochastic agreement statistic.
C3 usability instrument, task protocol and reviewer/edit denominator.
universal_null_rule: No eligible labelled cases or a zero rate denominator produces NULL or N/A with a recorded reason, never a measured zero. A genuine zero requires an executed eligible observation and a positive denominator. Missing telemetry is not zero.
limitations: The exhibit is conceptual and non-empirical; it contains no result value, sample size, acceptance threshold, condition ranking, time saving, cost outcome, usability result or production claim.
TO FREEZE is an intentional evidence hold. The named denominators and aggregation choices require prospective supervisor, domain, ethics or statistical review before confirmatory execution.
Claim-support, answer correctness, provenance completeness and locator validity are distinct properties; a traceable or cited claim can still be unsupported or wrong.
Repeated fields and claims within a company/report, and repeated tasks by one reviewer, are clustered rather than independent observations.
Event-linkage and reviewer outcomes are null in current D0. Human time, C0/C3 utility and reviewer edit burden require authorised participant observations.
Cost requires execution-date official pricing, exact formula and currency. Absent telemetry or pricing remains null rather than estimated.
The complete plain-text companion supplies a linear reading order; no claim is made that a downstream dissertation PDF is tagged.
